task_description: Clarify AmberKeeper desktop UI/data-management redesign needs for multi-provider chat cache browsing, session preview, management actions, and execution planning.
initial_idea: 完善 AmberKeeper 当前项目的 UI，重点深度研究设置里的数据管理、多 chat 缓存查看与管理、session 详情查看、预览体验、删除/导出功能，并规划后续 $plan 执行。

rounds.question: 如果这次只允许我们优先把一个核心用户任务做到明显更好，你最想优化的是哪一种？
rounds.answer: 希望可以管理多个历史缓存数据，然后做到更像知识库那样，方便用户，提高用户体验
notes: Primary intent appears to be cross-history management plus knowledge-base-like review UX.
User-experience improvement is stated, but concrete target workflows and boundaries remain unclear.

rounds.question: 用户在一周后重新打开 AmberKeeper，想找回之前某次聊过的重要内容时，理想流程应该是什么？
rounds.answer: 用户点击左下角设置作为统一入口，打开后有清晰区分和总览导航菜单，可进入各 provider。点开后看到 session 列表，整行平铺可点击，打开可浏览的该 session 聊天历史界面。后续可考虑打开原对话跳转对应 chat 历史，但可后置。session 右侧可单独导出或删除；provider 级别可导出所有 session，对应界面某处要有导出格式控制。
notes: Desired flow now includes unified settings entry, provider navigation, session list, session detail browsing, per-session delete/export, provider-level bulk export, export format control.
User already de-prioritized reopen-original-chat as later phase, which starts to define a non-goal, but IA boundary between Settings vs Library remains unresolved.

rounds.question: 如果必须二选一，你更想要哪种信息架构？A 设置作为统一入口，还是 B 把现有 Library 升级成知识库？并说一句为什么不选另一个。
rounds.answer: B，单独用一个知识库作为一级入口，感觉更符合我们这个产品对于数据重要管理的定位，好像也合适。
notes: User chose separate first-class knowledge-base entry instead of burying data management under Settings.
Contrarian pressure applied by forcing rejection of the alternative IA. Rejection rationale is directionally clear but still not operationally bounded.

rounds.question: 第一阶段（MVP）你最想明确不做的 2~3 件事是什么？
rounds.answer: 1. 自动跳转对应历史对话，不要
notes: Non-goal capture started but incomplete; only one item provided.
Need at least one more non-goal to keep MVP bounded.

rounds.question: 再补 1 个你明确不想在 MVP 做的能力。
rounds.answer: 不做全文搜索、不做 AI 自动摘要和命名、不做复杂权限回收站
notes: Non-goals are now explicit: no auto reopen/jump, no full-text search, no AI auto-summary/naming, no complex permission/recycle-bin systems.
Scope boundary is much clearer, but MVP default decisions and success metrics remain unresolved.

rounds.question: 下面 3 件事，你是否允许我默认自行决定？
rounds.answer: session标题，在缓存的时候，应该就可以获取到provider chat自己生产的标题了，我们不用再做处理呀，除非你没有把这个标题的信息缓存下来；其他的你都可以自己决定
notes: User allows default decisions except for session-title strategy.

Evidence follow-up needed: capture pipeline carries page/document title in some paths, but current conversations persistence schema has no title column, so provider-native titles are not currently stored for library listing.
Simplifier pressure introduced a concrete MVP boundary: independent knowledge-base IA and limited delete/export scope can be decided autonomously.

rounds.question: 你是否同意把“持久化 provider 原生 session 标题（并为旧数据提供降级显示）”纳入 MVP？
notes: Decision boundary now explicit: MVP may include schema/storage/UI work to persist provider-native session titles with fallback for legacy data.
Remaining weakest area is success criteria: what counts as 'good enough' UX for first release.

rounds.question: 第一阶段完成后，你最希望看到哪类结果最明显？
notes: Top acceptance theme: make data feel like a real product asset via richer titles/list/detail metadata.
Need one more pass to operationalize which metadata matters most in list/detail for acceptance testing.

rounds.question: 如果一个 session 列表项要看起来像真正有价值的档案，你最想优先看到的 3 个信息是什么？
rounds.answer: 1. 标题 2. 消息数 3. 最后更新时间
notes: Acceptance focus is now concrete at the list-item level: title, message count, updated time are the essential archive signals.
Ontologist pass reduced 'knowledge base' into its minimal visible essence: records must present meaningful identity, size, and recency.

notable_gaps: provider-native titles not persisted in conversations schema
